raw_response: {"diagnosis":"On 2026-01-18 the source began sending reversals as separate REVERSAL rows (orig_txn_id points to the original) and stopped updating the original, which stays POSTED. The pipeline keeps only POSTED rows, so reversed originals are still counted and gold totals are too high. Before the change, reversed originals were marked REVERSED and excluded.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.8,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(r.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, r.customer_id, CAST(r.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(r.amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(r.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE r.status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions x WHERE x.status = 'REVERSAL' AND x.orig_txn_id IS NOT NULL AND x.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
